query: Bally's construction targets: 10 percent women, 40 percent minorities, 10 percent service-disabled veterans.

facts.text: Bally's Bronx targeted 10% women among construction workers.
Bally's Bronx targeted 40% minorities among construction workers.
The Board identified a 10% service-disabled-veteran construction workforce target.
The applicant's own construction workforce chart uses the broader category of veterans for its 10% target.
Bally's application separately describes a 35% MWBE participation goal.
Bally's application separately describes 5% spending with service-disabled-veteran-owned firms.
The Bronx license requires public progress reports on workforce diversity and demographic data.
The Bronx license requires independent monitoring of community benefit milestones.

conditions.text: Women comprised 10% of the actual Bronx construction workforce on the relevant contractor-inclusive denominator.
Minority workers comprised 40% of that Bronx construction workforce.
Service-disabled veterans comprised 10% of that Bronx construction workforce under the approved veteran definition.

reference_verdict.reasoning: Code the beneficiary as construction workers. Verify attainment with contractor-inclusive workforce data and a defined denominator and reporting period. Confirm the veteran category in the approved reporting definition.
